info.title: Cabros Bot API
info.description: Protected alerting and market-analysis APIs. Machine clients use the x-api-key header; the api-key query parameter exists only for legacy compatibility and may leak through logs. The browser admin console can use Firebase ID tokens on documented admin operations when ENABLE_FIREBASE_ADMIN_AUTH=true.

get.description: Bounded read of the alertReplays audit collection. Each POST /api/alerts/{alertId}/replay creates a unique document so retries with the same idempotency key do not overwrite prior attempts; raw idempotency keys are never returned. Use the optional alertId query to scope the result to a single stored alert.

parameters.name: alertId
parameters.description: Optional stored alert id to filter replay attempts.

X-Shadow-Mode-Metrics.description: JSON-encoded shadow-mode outcome metrics payload emitted by SignalOutcomeService.getMetricsSummary(). Returns the string "No measurements found" when signal-outcome tracking is disabled or no measurements exist. Object form (when tracking is enabled with data) follows the ShadowModeMetrics schema: coverage buckets, per-window hitRatePercent/targetHitRatePercent/stopHitRatePercent/expectancyR plus drawdown proxy and latency/cost metadata. Omitted when source or enriched filters are supplied because the shadow-mode metrics service has no matching filters.

get.description: Response includes an ETag header (e.g. ETag: "3") that mirrors the preset's monotonic version. Supply it on PUT or DELETE via If-Match to opt into optimistic concurrency.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency token (e.g. "3"). When present and not equal to the current preset version, the request returns 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED with the current preset so the client can rebase. When omitted, the write succeeds and increments version (backwards-compatible default). A malformed token (e.g. a comma-separated entity-tag list or the wildcard "*") returns 400 INVALID_IF_MATCH instead of being silently dropped.

400.description: Malformed request body, or malformed If-Match header (e.g. a comma-separated entity-tag list or the wildcard "*").

409.description: Preset is locked by an in-flight sweep (lockedUntil > now). Response body includes code=PRESET_LOCKED and the lockedUntil timestamp; the current preset is also returned so the client can decide whether to retry.

412.description: If-Match version does not match the current preset version. Response body includes code=PRECONDITION_FAILED and the current preset so the client can rebase.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency token (e.g. "3"). When present and not equal to the current preset version, the request returns 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED with the current preset so the client can rebase. When omitted, the delete proceeds (backwards-compatible default). A malformed token (e.g. a comma-separated entity-tag list or the wildcard "*") returns 400 INVALID_IF_MATCH instead of being silently dropped.

400.description: Malformed If-Match header. Use a quoted integer such as "3" or the weak form W/"3".

412.description: If-Match version does not match the current preset version. Response body includes code=PRECONDITION_FAILED and the current preset so the client can rebase.

404.description: The requested Binance order was not found.

post.summary: Validate or submit a Binance Spot order
post.description: Live requests require an idempotency key or clientOrderId. Decimal quantities, prices, and quote amounts may be strings to preserve precision. MARKET orders must omit timeInForce. Binance PERCENT_PRICE, PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE, and account-dependent filters such as MAX_POSITION or MAX_NUM_ORDERS use Binance order-test validation before acceptance. Definitive pre-execution or exchange rejections return 400 BINANCE_ORDER_REJECTED; a reconciled order mismatch returns 409 BINANCE_ORDER_CONFLICT; transient order-test failures return retryable 502 BINANCE_VALIDATION_FAILED. Binance execution-unknown code -1006 remains BINANCE_ORDER_STATUS_UNKNOWN.

409.description: The idempotency key conflicts with the request, or the recovered Binance order does not match the requested order.

value.error: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload
Reconciled Binance order does not match the request

delete.summary: Cancel a resting Binance Spot order
delete.description: Cancels a single open or partially filled Binance Spot order using the same admin/feature gates as POST. The body must include the symbol plus exactly one of orderId or origClientOrderId; ambiguous requests return 400 INVALID_ORDER_REQUEST. Already-terminal orders (Binance error -2011, "Unknown order sent", or -2013) return 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND without re-firing at Binance. Definitive rejections return 400 BINANCE_REQUEST_REJECTED; transient provider failures return retryable 502 BINANCE_QUERY_FAILED.

200.description: Binance confirmed the cancel; the sanitized cancelled order is returned.

404.description: The requested Binance order is already terminal (filled, cancelled, expired, or rejected).

FirebaseBearerAuth.description: Firebase ID token for the browser admin console. Requires an admin.viewer or admin.operator custom claim; webhook operations remain API-key-only.

IdempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client-generated key. Matching concurrent or sequential requests replay the original response and jobId; reuse with a different request fingerprint returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. The response includes Idempotency-Replay: false for the first request and true for a replay. The x-idempotency-key header is also supported.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Optional replay key. Canonical header form (x-idempotency-key is also supported).

IdempotencyKeyQuerySnake.description: Optional legacy-compatible replay key query parameter.

BinanceOrderFailure.description: Binance rejected or could not confirm the order. Definitive exchange rejections return BINANCE_ORDER_REJECTED; transient order-test failures return BINANCE_VALIDATION_FAILED. A live request with an idempotency key derives a deterministic clientOrderId for reconciliation after cache expiration or process restart. A 503 BINANCE_ORDER_STATUS_UNKNOWN response is replayed for the same idempotency key; do not resubmit with a new key until the order status is reconciled.

example.error: Binance accepted or may have accepted the order, but its final status is unknown; do not resubmit with a new idempotency key

AlertDetailResult.description: Stored alert detail with the latest replay metadata

AlertSummaryResult.description: Protected stored-alert analytics summary including bounded risk-metadata coverage and safe prompt provenance groups

ScannerPresetResult.description: Scanner preset response including the effective durable or ephemeral storage mode. GET, POST, and PUT responses set an ETag header that mirrors the preset version (e.g. "3"); supply it back on PUT or DELETE via If-Match to opt into optimistic concurrency.

ETag.description: Optimistic-concurrency token mirroring the preset version. Format is a quoted integer (e.g. "3"). Supply via If-Match on PUT or DELETE to enforce a version check.

MessageDeliveryResult.description: Generic-message delivery response. A replay returns the cached body with idempotencyReplayed=true and Idempotency-Replay: true.

Idempotency-Replay.description: false for the first accepted request, true for a cached replay.

MessageIdempotencyConflict.description: The generic-message idempotency key was already used with a different message or routing payload.

example.error: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload

DeliveryResult.description: Per-channel delivery result. When ENABLE_ALERT_SIGNAL_REPEAT_SUPPRESSION is enabled and the same exchange/symbol/timeframe/side signal fires within its cooldown window, the response includes suppressedRepeat: true with empty results and deliveredChannels while the alert remains persisted with a suppression marker.

SymbolAnalysisResult.description: Single-symbol TradingView analysis, formatted alert text, risk levels, and decision metadata.

NewsMonitorAnalysisResult.description: News monitor analysis and delivery result

JobList.description: Bounded list of sanitized asynchronous job summaries

StatusResult.description: Non-sensitive runtime readiness. When Firebase Remote Config is enabled, dependencies.firebaseRemoteConfig reports loader metadata only; it never exposes remote parameter values or credentials.

jobId.description: Durably stored job identifier returned when queue acceptance is indeterminate.

populationNote.example: Metrics represent 40 evaluated signals out of 50 total received signals (80% coverage).

bySide.description: Per-side breakdown mirroring the parent WindowStats shape. Each side block is emitted only when at least one evaluated signal exists for that side.

bySetupType.description: Per-setup-type breakdown mirroring the parent WindowStats shape. Each setup-type block is emitted only when at least one evaluated signal exists for that setup.

ShadowModeMetrics.description: Aggregated shadow-mode outcome metrics emitted by SignalOutcomeService.getMetricsSummary(). The object form is returned only when totalSignalsReceived > 0 and signal-outcome tracking is enabled. When the service has no data or tracking is disabled, the field becomes the string sentinel "No measurements found". Win-rate semantics (see issue GH-593): hitRatePercent counts evaluated window outcomes whose return > 0; targetHitRatePercent/stopHitRatePercent count explicit target/stop hits including firstHit fallbacks and use barrier-eligible denominators (evaluated outcomes without a configured target or stop are excluded instead of counted as misses); expectancyR averages rMultiple over evaluated windows with finite rMultiple. All rates use evaluated-window denominators and zero-fill when none are eligible.

StoredAlert.description: Stored alert document. The `source` field identifies the producing flow (webhook, news-monitor, market-scanner, expanded-analysis). When the report text exceeded the 20,000-character storage cap, `truncated: true` and `originalLength` are populated so consumers and replay can flag the loss; replay will redeliver only the truncated text.

truncated.description: True when the stored text was clipped to the 20,000-character cap; see originalLength for the pre-truncation size.

originalLength.description: Length of the original alert text in characters before the 20,000-character cap was applied.

ReplayAttempt.description: Audit record for a single replay attempt. Each call to POST /api/alerts/{alertId}/replay creates a unique document so repeated replays with the same idempotency key do not overwrite prior attempts; the HTTP Idempotency-Replay contract is preserved upstream by the idempotency middleware. Raw idempotency keys are never persisted; only a SHA-256 hash prefix is exposed so attempts can be grouped without leaking the caller-supplied key.

id.description: Opaque replay-attempt identifier; use this value for display and audit references, not as the Firestore document ID.

idempotencyKeyHashPrefix.description: First 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 hash of the supplied idempotency key. The raw key is never stored or returned.

byFeatureFlag.description: Includes tradingViewData for requested MCP enrichment, tradingViewDataApplied for successfully applied MCP results, and withoutTradingViewData for requests that did not opt in.

tradingViewStatusCounts.description: Counts TradingView enrichment outcomes; requested alerts without a stored status are reported as unrecorded.

evidenceCoverage.description: Tracks whether enriched alerts cited grounding sources. Denominator counts only enriched alerts; legacy records missing a sources field count as zero. Grouped by prompt provenance (Langfuse vs. local fallback) for regression attribution.

denominator.description: Number of enriched alerts included in this coverage window.

totalSourceCount.description: Sum of all source counts across enriched alerts in the window.

averageSourceCount.description: Average number of cited sources per enriched alert. 0 when denominator is 0.

byPromptProvenance.description: Per-provenance breakdown (Langfuse version, local fallback, etc.) using the same bucket shape.

shadowModeMetrics.description: Aggregated shadow-mode outcome metrics. When an object, includes the full OutcomesSummary payload (coverage buckets, per-window WindowStats with hit/target/stop rates and expectancyR, drawdown proxy, latency/cost metadata, and falsePositiveCandidates). When no data is available or signal-outcome tracking is disabled, the value is the string sentinel "No measurements found". Equity providers remain opt-in and fail open. This field is omitted when source or enriched filters are supplied because shadow-mode metrics do not support those filters. Win-rate field semantics: hitRatePercent counts evaluated window outcomes whose return > 0; targetHitRatePercent/stopHitRatePercent count explicit target/stop hits (including firstHit fallbacks) over barrier-eligible denominators only; expectancyR averages finite rMultiple over evaluated windows.

version.description: Monotonic per-preset version used for optimistic concurrency. Increment by 1 on every successful update. Echoed as the ETag response header and accepted via the If-Match request header on PUT/DELETE.

ScannerPresetConflictResponse.description: Conflict response for scanner-preset If-Match / lockedUntil failures. Returned with HTTP 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED and HTTP 409 PRESET_LOCKED so the client can rebase or wait for the scheduler lease to release.

error.description: Human-readable explanation of why the request was rejected.

preset.description: Current preset state, including its monotonic version, so the client can rebase.

lockedUntil.description: Echoed on 409 PRESET_LOCKED responses so the client knows when the scheduler lease expires.

CallbackFields.description: When callbackUrl is configured, each callback POST includes x-callback-timestamp (ISO-8601), x-callback-event, and a UUID x-callback-delivery-id. If a callback secret is configured (via callbackSecret or JOB_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET), x-callback-signature is sent containing an HMAC-SHA256 hex digest over the newline-delimited timestamp, event, delivery ID, and raw JSON body. The secret itself is never transmitted. Hostname callback delivery is pinned to the public DNS answers that passed private-address validation for that attempt, preventing a second lookup from selecting a private destination; ALLOW_PRIVATE_CALLBACKS=true is an explicit override. Receivers should reject stale timestamps and deduplicate delivery IDs; retries use new IDs and signatures.

callbackUrl.description: HTTPS URL to receive a POST with the job result when it reaches a terminal state (or a configured intermediate event). HTTP is allowed only for localhost in development. Hostname callback connections are pinned to the validated public DNS answers for each attempt; any private DNS answer is rejected unless ALLOW_PRIVATE_CALLBACKS=true.

callbackSecret.description: Optional shared secret used to generate the x-callback-signature HMAC-SHA256 header. The secret is used server-side to compute the signature and is never transmitted in callback requests.

callbackEvents.description: Events that trigger a callback delivery. Defaults to all terminal events: completed, failed, cancelled, timed_out.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for the job in milliseconds. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes). Hard cap at 600000 (10 minutes).

dryRun.description: When true, analyze without notification delivery or persistence. The query parameter form is supported for GET and POST.

telegramThreadId.description: Optional Telegram forum topic message_thread_id override (0 routes to the chat general topic).

dryRun.description: Present and true when analysis generated alerts without dispatching or persisting them.

quota_exhausted.description: Number of symbols that exhausted Gemini 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED retries.

requestedChannels.description: Channels selected for delivery; in dry-run mode these are intended channels.

deliveredChannels.description: Channels that actually received alerts; empty in dry-run mode.

suppressedRepeat.description: True when this alert was persisted without channel delivery because it repeated a recent signal.

requestId.description: Request correlation ID echoed from the inbound x-request-id header or generated as a UUIDv4.

tradingViewEnrichmentApplied.description: True only when TradingView MCP data was successfully applied to this enrichment.

tradingViewEnrichmentStatus.description: Sanitized TradingView MCP outcome for this alert.

levelsSource.description: Provenance of technical_levels. Set to 'gemini-grounding' only when Gemini-parsed fallback levels are emitted because TradingView MCP data was absent or failed; omitted when MCP-derived levels win (GH-509 / CB-226).

current_price.description: Current price supplied by TradingView MCP enrichment; null when unavailable.

sentiment_score_raw.description: Original signed Gemini sentiment score when the effective score was capped because grounding returned no sources.

price_data.description: Optional structured TradingView MCP price snapshot (e.g. current_price, high, low).

setup_evidence.description: Optional one-line rationale or observed market structure supporting the setup_type

idempotencyReplayed.description: Present and true when the response was replayed from a matching idempotency key.

status.description: Current job status. Terminal statuses are: completed, failed, cancelled, timed_out.

callbackStatus.description: Callback delivery state, present only when a callbackUrl was configured.

results.description: Per-symbol analysis results (expanded-analysis jobs only, when completed).

scanResults.description: Per-scan results (market-scanner jobs only, when completed). Ranked jobs include scores with symbol, score, reason, and optional trendConfluence entries.

alertText.description: Formatted alert text delivered to notification channels (completed jobs only).

error.description: Error message (failed or timed_out jobs only).

code.description: Machine-readable error code (failed or timed_out jobs only).

symbol.description: Allow-listed Binance Spot symbol, for example BTCUSDT.

quantity.description: Base-asset quantity. Required for LIMIT. Optional for MARKET (evaluated using average price against the notional cap; MARKET BUYs are converted to an exchange-enforced quoteOrderQty at the estimated average price). Send as a string when exact decimal precision matters.

quoteOrderQty.description: Quote-asset amount for MARKET orders. Send as a string when exact decimal precision matters.

price.description: Required for LIMIT orders. Send as a string when exact decimal precision matters.

timeInForce.description: LIMIT-only. MARKET orders must omit this field.

clientOrderId.description: Stable Binance order identity. Required for live requests unless an idempotency key is supplied.

dryRun.description: Validate filters and notional without submitting. Set false only for an enabled operator workflow.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional body form of the idempotency key. Header form is preferred and required for live requests without clientOrderId.

idempotency_key.description: Optional snake_case body form of the idempotency key.

Status.description: Runtime status. TradingView dependencies expose configured endpoint metadata plus runtime status (unknown before an MCP operation, ready after success, degraded after failure), timestamps, sanitized error categories, success/failure counters, and dependencies.tradingViewMcp.enrichment.alertPath rolling 24-hour alert-path outcome rates without provider response bodies. dependencies.geminiQuota reports Gemini quota cooldown state, remaining cooldown duration, trigger counters, Brave search fallback events during cooldown, and grounding request telemetry counters without exposing prompt text or provider credentials. dependencies.groundingCoalescing reports the bounded equity-alert search sharing window and hit/miss/failure counters. featureFlags.firestoreJobStorage reports the ENABLE_FIRESTORE_JOB_STORAGE gate or the legacy ENABLE_FIRESTORE_ALERT_STORAGE gate; featureFlags.jobExecutionWorker reports JOB_EXECUTION_MODE=render-worker or firestore-poller; dependencies.jobExecutionQueue reports queue readiness and safe operational counters without broker credentials; featureFlags.firestoreScannerPresets reports ENABLE_FIRESTORE_SCANNER_PRESETS; dependencies.scannerPresetStorage reports the effective durable or ephemeral scanner-preset backend and readiness; dependencies.signalOutcomeWorker reports the scheduler role (web, worker, or disabled), graceful-shutdown state, cadence, heartbeat, and scanned/pending/evaluated/error counters; a disabled local scheduler reports ready false and status disabled because it is not the process evaluating outcomes; dependencies.firestoreJobStorage reports Firestore credential readiness for that runtime path; featureFlags.newsMonitorTestMode reports ENABLE_NEWS_MONITOR_TEST_MODE without changing news monitor behavior; featureFlags.messageFooterMetadata reports ENABLE_MESSAGE_FOOTER_METADATA and defaults to true unless explicitly set to false; featureFlags.cloudflareAig reports ENABLE_CLOUDFLARE_AIG and dependencies.cloudflareAig reports Cloudflare AI Gateway credential readiness; featureFlags.equityMarketData reports ENABLE_EQUITY_MARKET_DATA and dependencies.equityMarketData reports non-sensitive Twelve Data readiness for BATS/NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX/NYSE ARCA outcome evaluation; featureFlags.firebaseRemoteConfig reports ENABLE_FIREBASE_REMOTE_CONFIG and dependencies.firebaseRemoteConfig reports only bounded loader metadata, source, template version, last successful load, last error category, and consecutive failures without remote values or credentials; featureFlags.notificationRedrive reports ENABLE_NOTIFICATION_REDRIVE and dependencies.notificationRedrive reports dead-letter redrive worker role, configuration, running state, and safe operational counters. featureFlags.alertSignalRepeatSuppression reports ENABLE_ALERT_SIGNAL_REPEAT_SUPPRESSION and dependencies.alertSignalRepeatSuppression reports the enabled state plus non-sensitive suppression counters (suppressedCount, lastSuppressedAt, activeTrackedSignals).

FirebaseRemoteConfigDependency.description: Safe runtime metadata for Firebase Remote Config server-side template loader without returning remote parameter values or secrets.

enabled.description: Whether Firebase Remote Config is enabled via ENABLE_FIREBASE_REMOTE_CONFIG.

ready.description: True only after a successful, fresh server template load; false if uninitialized, disabled, misconfigured, failed, or stale.

status.description: Granular lifecycle state of the server template loader.

templateVersion.description: Version number of the currently loaded Remote Config template, or null.

lastSuccessfulLoad.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent successful template load, or null.

lastErrorCategory.description: Sanitized error category if the last load failed or values are stale (timeout, credentials, unsupported_sdk, load_failed, stale), or null.

consecutiveFailures.description: Count of consecutive failed template loads since last success; reset to 0 on success.

refreshIntervalMs.description: Configured background refresh interval in milliseconds.

maxAgeMs.description: Configured cache max age in milliseconds before values are considered stale.

symbol.description: Allow-listed Binance Spot symbol, for example BTCUSDT.

orderId.description: Binance-assigned order ID returned by the original POST /api/trading/binance/orders response. Provide exactly one of orderId or origClientOrderId.

origClientOrderId.description: Stable client-side order ID originally submitted with the order. Provide exactly one of orderId or origClientOrderId.
